The film composition and residual contamination level were evaluated by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA). The film structure was evaluated by a RHEED apparatus with information depth of about 2–10 nm and a Philips powder x-ray diffractometer (XRD). Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was applied for some samples. The electrical measurements were carried out on Al/HfO2/Si capacitors. Capacitance-voltage curves were recorded using a HP 4284A precision LCR-meter. The current-voltage curves were measured with a Keithley 2400 Source Meter. The film composition and residual contamination level were evaluated by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA).
